YES SHE HAS PASSED ALL THE TESTS.exampleZh: Has the new co-worker finished the training program? (新同事完成訓練計畫了嗎？)

YES BUT THEY WILL CHARGE AN EXTRA FEE.word: yes, but they will charge an extra fee.
YES BUT THEY WILL CHARGE AN EXTRA FEE.meaning: 但他們會收取額外費用
YES BUT THEY WILL CHARGE AN EXTRA FEE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES BUT THEY WILL CHARGE AN EXTRA FEE.exampleZh: If we hire professional movers, will they pack the boxes too? (如果我們雇請專業搬家工人，他們也會打包箱子嗎？)

YES BUT IT MIGHT HURT YOUR FINGERS.word: yes, but it might hurt your fingers.
YES BUT IT MIGHT HURT YOUR FINGERS.meaning: 但可能會刮傷你的手指
YES BUT IT MIGHT HURT YOUR FINGERS.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES BUT IT MIGHT HURT YOUR FINGERS.exampleZh: If the screen is cracked, can it still be used? (如果螢幕裂了，還能用嗎？)

YES HE SAID NOTHING IS BROKEN.word: yes, he said nothing is broken.
YES HE SAID NOTHING IS BROKEN.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES HE SAID NOTHING IS BROKEN.exampleZh: Has your swollen ankle been examined by a specialist? (你腫脹的腳踝給專科醫生檢查過了嗎？)

TRY RESTARTING THE ROUTER IN THE HALLWAY.word: try restarting the router in the hallway.
TRY RESTARTING THE ROUTER IN THE HALLWAY.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
TRY RESTARTING THE ROUTER IN THE HALLWAY.exampleZh: If the wifi signal is lost, what should we do? (如果 wifi 訊號斷了，我們該怎麼辦？)

THE AIR IS NOT SAFE FOR HUMANS.word: the air is not safe for humans.
THE AIR IS NOT SAFE FOR HUMANS.meaning: 出大氣主要由二氧化碳組成
THE AIR IS NOT SAFE FOR HUMANS.example: The word is the air is not safe for humans..
THE AIR IS NOT SAFE FOR HUMANS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文指出大氣主要由二氧化碳組成，人類呼吸它將無法生存（will not survive），因此空氣對人類不安全

THE MOON BLOCKS THE SUN.example: 【短文】閱讀「the sun is blocked by the moon」後，選出符合文意的選項：
THE MOON BLOCKS THE SUN.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文中開頭直接說明「the sun is blocked by the moon」（太陽被月亮遮住），這就是日食的原因

IT PULLS OBJECTS DOWN TO THE GROUND.word: it pulls objects down to the ground.
IT PULLS OBJECTS DOWN TO THE GROUND.example: 【短文】閱讀「keeps us on the ground」後，選出符合文意的選項：
IT PULLS OBJECTS DOWN TO THE GROUND.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文中提到重力會將物體拉向彼此，且「keeps us on the ground」（讓我們留在地面）

HAS NOT BEEN.example: We should focus on the usage of has not been in modern English.
HAS NOT BEEN.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「單數」的核心用法。

TO AVOID CONFUSING CUSTOMERS.example: The word is to avoid confusing customers..
TO AVOID CONFUSING CUSTOMERS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文中表示如果不清楚標示退貨政策，顧客可能會困惑（might get confused），因此法律規定需提供明確指示，目的在於避免顧客困惑，選 B

MODIFIED.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「已經被修改」。

FURNITURE.example: We bought modern wooden furniture for our new living room yesterday.
FURNITURE.exampleZh: 我們昨天為新客廳買了現代風的木製家具。

examples.en: The delivery workers are moving heavy furniture up the stairs.
examples.zh: 搬運工人正在把沉重的家具搬上樓梯。

examples.en: This sofa was the most expensive piece of furniture in the showroom.
examples.zh: 這張沙發是展示中心裡最昂貴的一件家具。

HAS THE VOICEMAIL BEEN CHECKED YET.word: has the voicemail been checked yet
HAS THE VOICEMAIL BEEN CHECKED YET.meaning: 語音信箱已經被查看過了嗎？
HAS THE VOICEMAIL BEEN CHECKED YET.example: Has the voicemail been checked yet.
HAS THE VOICEMAIL BEEN CHECKED YET.exampleZh: 語音信箱已經被查看過了嗎？

IF THE SOUP IS SPICY I CANNOT EAT IT.word: if the soup is spicy i cannot eat it
IF THE SOUP IS SPICY I CANNOT EAT IT.meaning: 如果湯很辣我就不喝了
IF THE SOUP IS SPICY I CANNOT EAT IT.example: If the soup is spicy i cannot eat it.
IF THE SOUP IS SPICY I CANNOT EAT IT.exampleZh: 如果湯很辣我就不喝了。

IF YOU ATTEND WE WILL BE HAPPY.word: if you attend we will be happy
IF YOU ATTEND WE WILL BE HAPPY.meaning: 如果你出席，我們會很高興
IF YOU ATTEND WE WILL BE HAPPY.example: If you attend we will be happy.
IF YOU ATTEND WE WILL BE HAPPY.exampleZh: 如果你出席，我們會很高興。

THE REFUND HAS NOT BEEN GIVEN YET.word: the refund has not been given yet
THE REFUND HAS NOT BEEN GIVEN YET.example: The refund has not been given yet.

WE CAN TAKE THE MOUNTAIN ROAD INSTEAD.word: we can take the mountain road instead.
WE CAN TAKE THE MOUNTAIN ROAD INSTEAD.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
WE CAN TAKE THE MOUNTAIN ROAD INSTEAD.exampleZh: 英文原句：If the bridge is closed, which way should we drive? 意思：如果橋關閉了，我們該開哪條路？選項 D「我們可以改走山路」最合理

IS CONFIRMED.example: If the online payment is confirmed, the system will automatically generate an electronic receipt for you.
IS CONFIRMED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：這是稍微進階的融合題。

HAS BEEN TRANSFORMED.example: Over the past few months, the old library has been transformed into a modern community center.
HAS BEEN TRANSFORMED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：時間副詞 Over the past few months 需搭配現在完成式；而圖書館是「被改造」的，因此要用現在完成式的被動語態 (has been + p.p.)

DO NOT RESOLVE.example: If they do not resolve the issue immediately, the problem will only get worse.
DO NOT RESOLVE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：第一類條件句中，主要子句用未來式 (will get)，If 子句需用現在式。

HAS IMPROVED.meaning: 從過去持續到現在的進步
HAS IMPROVED.example: Since the new manager arrived, communication between the teams has improved significantly.
HAS IMPROVED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：Since 子句用過去式，主要子句須搭配現在完成式 (has/have + p.p.)，表示從過去持續到現在的進步。

BE CHECKED.example: If you are traveling abroad, your passport must be checked before you book the flight.
BE CHECKED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：護照是「被檢查」的對象，助動詞 must 後面接原形，因此被動語態為 must + be + p.p. (be checked)

HAS REACHED.example: The company has reached its target for this quarter, so everyone will receive a bonus.
HAS REACHED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：公司「已經達到」本季的目標，結果是大家會拿到獎金。

WILL NOT BE SENT.example:
A: Have you reviewed the document? 
B: Yes, but I found some errors. If they are not corrected, the document will not be sent tonight.
WILL NOT BE SENT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用現在式的被動語態 (are not corrected)，主要子句表示未來的結果，須用未來式的被動語態，文件「將不會被寄出」(will not be sent)

PROTECT.example: We have to protect the environment.

examples.en: We have to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 我們必須保護環境。

examples.en: A good password will protect your online account.
examples.zh: 好的密碼將會保護你的線上帳號。

ARE INFLUENCED.example: The latest fashion trends are influenced by social media more than ever before.
ARE INFLUENCED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主詞 trends（趨勢）是複數，且是「被影響」的對象，所以要用現在式複數的被動語態 (are influenced)。

BY PASSING THE FINAL TEST.meaning: 如果你通過最終測驗，將會獲頒數位徽章
BY PASSING THE FINAL TEST.example:
【短文】Online Learning Platform: Welcome to the advanced coding course. The first video has been uploaded to your student account. If you pass the final test, a digital badge will be awarded to you. 
Question: How can a student get a digital badge?
BY PASSING THE FINAL TEST.exampleZh: 文中說明「If you pass the final test, a digital badge will be awarded to you.（如果你通過最終測驗，將會獲頒數位徽章）」，故選 C

PAY ATTENTION TO SPELLING.meaning: 如果想要更高的分數，必須更仔細檢查拼字
PAY ATTENTION TO SPELLING.example:
Message from Tutor: I have checked your recent assignments. Your writing has gotten much better lately. However, if you want a higher grade, you must check your spelling more carefully. 
Question: What does the tutor advise the student to do?
PAY ATTENTION TO SPELLING.exampleZh: 導師在訊息中提到「if you want a higher grade, you must check your spelling more carefully（如果想要更高的分數，必須更仔細檢查拼字）」，因此選 D。

NEW LOCAL RECORDS WERE SET.meaning: 年輕運動員打破了幾項當地紀錄
NEW LOCAL RECORDS WERE SET.example:
【短文】Sports News: The national swimming championship was held last weekend. Several local records were broken by the young athletes. If they keep practicing hard, they will join the Olympic team next year. 
Question: What happened at the swimming championship?
NEW LOCAL RECORDS WERE SET.exampleZh: 新聞中提到「Several local records were broken by the young athletes（年輕運動員打破了幾項當地紀錄）」，這表示建立了新紀錄，因此選 A

BECAUSE IT IS NOT ALLOWED INSIDE.word: because it is not allowed inside
BECAUSE IT IS NOT ALLOWED INSIDE.example:
【短文】Stadium Rule: All glass bottles are prohibited inside the arena. If you bring one, it will be taken away at the gate. Drinks can only be bought from the official stores inside. 
Question: Why will a glass bottle be taken away?
BECAUSE IT IS NOT ALLOWED INSIDE.exampleZh: 規定中說「All glass bottles are prohibited（所有玻璃瓶皆被禁止）」，這就是為什麼會被沒收（taken away）的原因

BY RESTARTING THE MAIN SERVER.meaning: 如果重啟主伺服器，應用程式將恢復運作
BY RESTARTING THE MAIN SERVER.example:
【短文】Tech Update: The popular social media app has crashed globally. Millions of users have been affected since this morning. Engineers say that if the main server is restarted, the app will work again. 
Question: How will the app be fixed?
BY RESTARTING THE MAIN SERVER.exampleZh: 工程師表示「if the main server is restarted, the app will work again（如果重啟主伺服器，應用程式將恢復運作）」，故選 D

THE DOOR LOCKS COMPLETELY.meaning: 如果輸入錯誤密碼三次，門將會完全鎖死
THE DOOR LOCKS COMPLETELY.example:
Internal Email: We have updated the office security system. A new access code has been sent to your phone. If you enter the wrong code three times, the door will be locked completely. 
Question: What happens after three wrong attempts?
THE DOOR LOCKS COMPLETELY.exampleZh: 信件中寫道「If you enter the wrong code three times, the door will be locked completely.（如果輸入錯誤密碼三次，門將會完全鎖死）」。

THE MARKETING TEAM.meaning: 今年的年度員工派對將由行銷團隊策劃
THE MARKETING TEAM.example:
Office Memo: The annual staff party will be planned by the marketing team this year. It will be held at a seaside restaurant. If you plan to go to the party, please answer this email before Wednesday. 
Question: Who is planning the staff party?
THE MARKETING TEAM.exampleZh: 備忘錄第一句為「The annual staff party will be planned by the marketing team this year.（今年的年度員工派對將由行銷團隊策劃）」，因此選 B。

DURING THE WEEKEND LIVE SESSIONS.meaning: 如果有問題，老師會在週末直播時段回答
DURING THE WEEKEND LIVE SESSIONS.example:
【短文】Language School: Our Spanish classes are designed for busy adults. Lessons are recorded and can be watched anytime. If you have questions, they will be answered by our teachers during the weekend live sessions. 
Question: When can students ask teachers questions directly?
DURING THE WEEKEND LIVE SESSIONS.exampleZh: 文中說明「If you have questions, they will be answered by our teachers during the weekend live sessions.（如果有問題，老師會在週末直播時段回答）」

WITH YELLOW SIGNS.meaning: 比賽路線已經用黃色標誌標示
WITH YELLOW SIGNS.example:
Running Club: Welcome to the city marathon! The race path has been marked with yellow signs. If you feel sick during the run, medical tents can be found every five kilometers. 
Question: How is the race path marked?
WITH YELLOW SIGNS.exampleZh: 文中的第二句是「The race path has been marked with yellow signs.（比賽路線已經用黃色標誌標示）」，故選 B。

CLOSE THE MAJOR HIGHWAYS.meaning: 今晚主要高速公路可能被警方封閉
CLOSE THE MAJOR HIGHWAYS.example:
Weather Alert: Heavy snow has been predicted for the northern region. Major highways might be closed by the police tonight. If you must travel, drive slowly and carry warm clothes. 
Question: What might the police do tonight?
CLOSE THE MAJOR HIGHWAYS.exampleZh: 警報中提到「Major highways might be closed by the police tonight.（今晚主要高速公路可能被警方封閉）」，因此選 C。
